notes.title: May Dev Log
notes.content:
Hi all,
We have been working hard in the past couple of months and finally breaking the radio silence to bring you news about what we have been cooking so far.

Gameplay

 Killing the boss at the end of the round rewards with powerful augments
 Bosses have their own unique attacks and death visual effects
 4 playable characters have been added and more to come
 There are now even more towers to choose from to set your gameplay strategy
 We increased the number of levels we have and they come with their own unique challenges 
 Gameplay is adjusted once more to be even more challenging
 Quarry and Sawmill have been updated to collect resources more efficiently


Creative

 In-game Character styles have been reworked for more updated look
 The UI has been updated once more to suit our style better
 Levels have their own cool ambient effects that makes the world feel more immersive
 Infusions system has been changed completely. Augments system is created instead.
 Rare augments have been added. Make sure to collect those to get more powerful
 We continue to update the particles and add new ones
 More sound effects are created and updated some old ones

Here are some sneak peek art works:

Coming Soon
We are working to release our game in 2025 but no exact dates just yet. Make sure to follow us and wishlist our game to stay in the loop for more updates! In the mean time go and enjoy our relaxing Main Menu music made by our very own talented Jomar.

notes.title: October Dev Log
notes.content:
Gameplay

 You can now level up towers to get unique visuals and effects
 Enemy types increased from 3 -> 7, Bosses with Special Abilities added to the game
 You can now play as Penny Bun with unique effects.
 There are now towers in the game that can buff other towers
 There are now findable objects in the level that can give powerful auras to your towers
 Gathering resources have been revamped.  Buildings now autogather resources around the map instead of producing their own.
 Bosses will now show up on the edges of the screen so you can better position towers
 Bosses now have a unique intro animation
 Game completely rebalanced to make it far more challenging
 Gold reworked to be a more unique findable resource


Creative

 In-game Character style has been changed and walk/carry animations have been implemented.
 The UI has been completely revamped.
 We have a beautiful animated Main Menu
 Infusions UI has been revamped
 Victory screen has been revamped
 Each tower now has a unique destroyed state
 Most Particles Have Been Updated
 Buildings now better show which resources you are missing
 Quarry and Sawmill Now have original assets
 Prima Materia now has a 3D style look
 Main gameplay sound track has been finished
 Dozens of sound effects updated and created


Hopeful Future Timeline
Oct: Launch Some Discord Playtests
Nov: Act on Discord Feedback & Add New Achievement Unlock System
Dec: Fun Features of Devs to Add + Holiday (we need our breaks too!)
Jan: Polish And Add Remaining Content
Feb: Prepare a lot of publishing initiatives.
March: Next Fest + Launch

notes.title: July 2024 Dev Log Update
notes.content:
This month!

- Due to playtest feedback we'll be focusing on making strategy and counters of enemies more dynamic in the coming months.
- Additionally we are trying to add variance from run-to-run
- Upgrades are too strong so we will tune them down in future playtest (note: They are intentionally cheap for playtests right now since we want people to experience the full game in a short 1-2hr time period)

Gameplay
    - We've added the ability to move your towers.  Your player can only pickup and move one tower at a time.  This is to add strategic depth in how you spend your time.  Additionally it allows a more reactive gameplay style to bosses by moving important towers in their path. Don't move too many though or your weak side will still be overrun!
    - We've added the ability to infuse towers.  As you progress through the story you'll gain the ability to grant other towers additional runes.  For example you may turn a tower into a blood tower and get all the bonuses that come alongside that.  This should allow for making your favorite towers all the more powerful.
    - We've added augments to the game.  After you defeat a boss you can pickup a powerful modifier.  These are random game to game and should shift your strategy.  Additionally they are intentionally unbalanced so you might get a crazy lucky run where you go insane.
    - We've added taunt towers to the game.  This allows you to better control monster flow and set up areas where a ton of towers can overlap to quickly destroy monsters.  They have more health than most towers (additionally most towers have had their HP decreased).
    - We've added a basic difficulty slider.  This can help give you more of a challenge when you grow stronger and yield you more prima materia (currency to buy upgrades).

Narrative
     - First story has been improved and polished more.
     - Narrative has taken over ownership of the socials so they'll be post more about characterse and the world there as well.  Be sure to follow us on TikTok or X!

Creative
    - We've narrowed down or visual style and started re-doing buildings.  Ice and Magic are the first on the update list.
    - VFX now has clearer guidelines and have updated most particles in the game.  We feel like we have a solid foundation now to finish the rest of the game.
    - We've added a handful of new towers to the game.

Hopeful Future Timeline
August: Leveling up towers, better balance and difficulty growth
Sept: Accessibility and Tutorial Features. Wider playtest for discord.
Oct: Act on discord feedback, increase content.
Nov: 2nd Discord Playtest
Dec: Fun Features of Devs to Add + Holiday (we need our breaks too!)
Jan: Act on Discord Feeedback
Feb: Prepare a lot of publishing initiatives.
March: Next Fest + Launch

notes.title: June 2024 Dev Log Update
notes.content:
This month!
- We've started our first friends and family playtest.  Currently it includes 1 level, 2 characters, 4 enemies, and a bunch of towers and upgrades.
- We've created level 2 & 3 and started developing the UI to not just be basic boxes.
- Gameplay: We've moved towards around 12 towers and revamped the early Towers to get them to the quality level we can support.
- Narrative: First story implemented, second story close to being implemented.  Updated our Visual Novel code to support our writers better.
- Creative: We've concepted and starting modeling up to about tower 16.  We've also brainstormed out about 50 possible towers and dozens of particle effects to choose the best from.
- Engineering: A lot of performance improvements for resources and particles.  Started investigating Friendshipper (an open source git implementation for UE5) that will help us scale the team if successful.

Hopeful Future Timeline (but we'll delay to make a better game if necessary):
July: Leveling Up Towers, More Content (Towers, Upgrades, Bosses), Augment System, Limited Invites via Discord to join a playtest.
August: Accessibility and Tutorial Features, All of Discord invited to join the playtest through a signup form.
September: Wider playtest on Steam.
October: Steam Next Fest
November: Launch Early Access
November - December: Launch v1.0 (we want a very short EA period, mostly as a way to hash out all the bugs before we go to full launch)

Feb/March: Secondary Launch Timeframe if we need more time. (We want to make the best game possible for you all!)

notes.title: May Devlog
notes.content:
Just wanted to drop some quick information for those waiting!

- First Playtest: Our first internal full team multiplayer playtest was this month.  It went "ok."  Definitely some bugs to fix but overall was pretty performant with 0 crashes.
- Family Playtest Soon: We'll be rolling out to our families this week or next to get some feedback on if the game makes sense.
- Cel-Shading: We've transitioned over to a cel-shading look for the 3D models to better blend with the 2D sprites.
- Creative: We've finished about 10 towers (40 desired for v1.0) and about 8 enemies (20-30 desired for v1.0).
- Gameplay: We've got most of the attributes done, upgrades, game loop, saving, multiplayer,  and character select done.
- Narrative: The world building & character design are primarily finished with the first story getting added to the game shortly.
- Engineering: Playtest uploaded to Steam and awaiting approval.  Steam hot-join working.  

Hopeful Future Timeline (but we'll delay to make a better game if necessary):
- June: Finish Bosses, Additional Levels, Leveling up Towers.
- July: Limited Invites via Discord to join a playtest.
- August: All of Discord invited to join the playtest through a signup form.
- September: Wider playtest on Steam.
- October: Steam Next Fest
- November: Launch Early Access
- November - December: Launch v1.0

Other Notes:
- Feel free to join our discord to discuss the game.
